metadata.title: Self Code Review
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Perform an independent code review of implementation changes in an isolated subagent context. Reviews code against the implementation plan, codebase patterns, and quality standards. Supports iterative loop-back to the implementation step when issues are found.

output.description: Code review findings — clean result or list of issues requiring fixes

prerequisites: Execute Implementation step completed with code changes
specificActions: MUST execute in an isolated subagent context (separate window) for independent review
Review all code changes from the Execute Implementation step
Compare changes against the implementation plan
Check for bugs, edge cases, and security issues
Track iteration count and respect maxIterations from template
If issues found and iterations < max: record findings in memory and signal loop-back
If clean or iterations >= max: proceed to next step
When looping back, findings must be stored in memory so the implementation step can read them

read: All files modified/created during implementation (from memory)

bestPractices: Review with fresh eyes — do not carry implementation context
Focus on substantive issues, not style nitpicks
Be specific: cite file, line, and what's wrong
Provide actionable fix suggestions, not vague complaints
Prioritize: bugs > security > logic errors > patterns > style
When iteration cap is reached, log a warning about unresolved findings

substeps.name: Load review context
actions: Read memory.json to get list of files modified/created
Read the implementation plan from memory
Determine current iteration number (check if reviewIteration exists in memory)

substeps.name: Review code changes
substeps.description: Examine each changed file in isolated context
actions: Use git diff to see all changes
Check for: correctness, pattern adherence, edge cases, security, naming conventions
If this is a subsequent iteration, focus on whether previous findings were addressed

substeps.name: Compile findings
substeps.description: Create structured list of issues found
actions: Categorize findings: bug, security, logic-error, pattern-violation, improvement
For each finding: file, location, description, severity, suggested fix
Determine overall verdict: clean (no actionable findings) or needs-fixes

substeps.name: Make loop decision
substeps.description: Decide whether to loop back or proceed
actions: If verdict is clean → proceed to next step
If verdict is needs-fixes AND iteration < maxIterations → store findings in memory, signal loop-back to Execute Implementation
If verdict is needs-fixes AND iteration >= maxIterations → log warning about unresolved findings, proceed to next step
Record reviewIteration, reviewFindings, and reviewDecision in memory

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
actions: Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Load context → Review changes (isolated) → Compile findings → Loop decision (back to implementation or proceed)

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Implementation results (filesModified, filesCreated, implementationProgress), implementation plan, previous review iterations
fields: Information Produced: reviewFindings (list of issues), reviewIteration (current iteration number), reviewDecision (clean/needs-fixes/cap-reached)
Decisions Made: Loop-back or proceed decision with justification
